title: Originality Attestation
body:
All contributors must complete this form before a commissioned work is accepted into inventory. Print, complete in ink, and return to Commissions. Incomplete forms will not be processed.

A work is original if it has not previously existed in any form. Resemblance to an existing work is grounds for rejection.

fields.label: Number of times the work was looked at before submission
I attest that this work has not previously existed

title: Warehouse Access
body:
Effective immediately, staff entering the warehouse must sign the access log at the loading dock. This applies to all staff regardless of department.

Bay 4 is not to be entered after 5:30 pm. Staff who require access to Bay 4 should make arrangements with Facilities during business hours.

Inventory is not to be moved between bays without a work order. Please do not rearrange items for any reason, including appearance.

Thank you for your cooperation.
